name: three_task_graph_hcl_integration_v1
purpose: engineering integration and code learning, not efficacy confirmation
model: existing frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B, same weights for controller, task tools and HCL metadata
tool_choice: model-generated JSON from visible question and HCL context; no task/stage oracle
data: deterministic first item of each existing StrictMedicalLoader role selection; no outcome-based replacement
test_policy: report-only; no test-derived forgetting probes; no state changes during test
privacy: all images and raw traces stay on the existing server; no external model API
stop: one integration run, report failures, no outcome-driven retuning or follow-on experiments
